name: ATM Completion Advice V 03
definition: The ATMCompletionAdvice message is sent by an ATM to an acquirer or its agent to inform of the result of a transaction performed on the ATM.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMCompletionAdvice.name: ATM Completion Advice
ATMCompletionAdvice.definition: Information related to the completion of an operation on the ATM.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
